bagPolicy.summary: Oriole Park at Camden Yards has implemented a clear bag policy to enhance safety and expedite entry. Approved bags include clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” and small clutches no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”.
allowed: Clear Bags (Plastic, vinyl or PVC) with no obscured interior pockets up to 12” x 6” x 12”
Small Clutch Bags/Wallets no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”
Seat cushions without pockets, zippers or concealable areas up to 18” wide
prohibited: Bags and wallets exceeding the size of a small clutch bag (6.5" W x 4.5" H)
Any bag larger than the permissible size (6.5" W x 4.5" H)
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags and medical bags are exceptions.

parking.note: Oriole Park at Camden Yards uses the Camden Yards Sports Complex lots near the B&O Warehouse plus numerous downtown Baltimore garages within walking distance. Prepaid parking is cheaper than drive-up, and the MARC/Light Rail Camden station is adjacent.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Oriole Park at Camden Yards's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The ballpark offers a variety of food and drink options including local and popular beers at the Beer Garden, comfort foods with a modern twist at Bridges Grille, and elevated classics at Cadillac Diner. Special offerings include a Bacon Wrapped Hot Dog and Pastrami Fry.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Oriole Park at Camden Yards, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Once in the ballpark, fans are not permitted to exit and re-enter ANY gate to receive multiple items. Fans requesting to leave the ballpark with re-entry permission should be directed to the Guest Services Center located behind home plate, where one of the above-mentioned individuals will be contacted for authorization.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Lockers will be located at the north end of the Warehouse by Gate H near the Main Box Office and outside of Gate A & C. The Orioles Box Office is located at the north end of the Warehouse by Gate H.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The Guest Experience Kiosks, located around the main concourse and on Eutaw Street, identified by light blue umbrellas, operate from the time the gates open until 15 minutes after the game ends. Gates open 2.5 hours before first pitch
